name: In5D Radio Player
author: gregg prescott

sections.description:
In5D Radio Player adds a compact, clean audio player to your WordPress site that your visitors can use to tune into In5D Radio, WIn5D, or In5D LIVE Talk, completely free.

Place it in your sidebar, embed it in any post or page with a shortcode, or drop it into any widget area. No floating bars, no pop-ups, just a self-contained player that fits wherever you put it.

In5D Radio is a 24/7 talk station covering consciousness, spiritual awakening, ET disclosure, and higher awareness. Hosted by Gregg Prescott, M.S., founder of In5D.com, serving the awakening community since April 2009.

WIn5D is a 24/7 music station playing original songs at 432Hz and 528Hz healing frequencies. Rock, Country, Pop, Metal, Ambient, Orchestral, every song inspired by In5D.com.

In5D LIVE Talk is a 24/7 station featuring live interviews, panel discussions, and conscious conversations exploring spirituality, awakening, and higher consciousness.

Features

  • Clean compact player, fits any sidebar or content area
  • Station toggle between In5D Radio (Talk), WIn5D (Music), and In5D LIVE Talk (Interviews)
  • Volume control
  • Accent color customizable to match your site
  • WordPress widget, drag and drop into any widget area
  • Shortcode [in5d_player] for inline embedding in posts and pages
  • “Powered by in5d.com” branding link (cannot be removed)
  • No floating bars, no pop-ups, no page takeovers
  • No API keys, no accounts, no setup beyond installing the plugin

Why Add This to Your Site?

Your visitors get free access to 24/7 conscious radio. You get a value-add for your audience at zero cost. And the awakening community grows a little stronger every time someone tunes in.

External Services

This plugin connects to external audio streaming servers to deliver live radio content.

The player loads audio streams from host.in5d.com when a visitor uses the player. The user’s browser connects directly to the stream server to retrieve audio. No personal data beyond a standard HTTP request is collected or transmitted.

Service provider: In5D Conscious Media Network
Terms of Service: https://in5d.com/terms-of-service/
Privacy Policy: https://in5d.com/privacy-policy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the in5d-radio-player folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Appearance > Widgets and drag In5D Radio Player into any sidebar
  4. Or use the shortcode [in5d_player] on any page or post
  5. Optional: Go to Settings > In5D Radio Player to set default station and accent color
sections.faq:
Is this really free?

Yes, completely free. No accounts, no API keys, no subscription.

Can I remove the “Powered by in5d.com” link?

No, the branding link is required to remain as part of using this plugin.

Can I embed it in a post or page?

Yes, use the shortcode [in5d_player] anywhere in your content.

What if the stream stops working?

The streams are maintained by In5D.com. If you notice an outage, check in5d.com for status updates.

Will this slow down my site?

No. The audio only loads when a visitor clicks play.
